# LACE

> LACE is the AI platform for the governed enterprise, built by Determinant
> Systems. It combines permissions-aware enterprise search, an evidence-locked
> bitemporal knowledge graph, policy-governed AI agents across every channel,
> and an app builder that turns a prompt into deployed software — on one
> substrate where provenance, policy enforcement, and audit are properties of
> the platform rather than conventions the application layer is trusted to
> follow.

LACE is a product of Determinant Systems (https://determinantsystems.com). It is
distinct from other products and organizations using the name "LACE" or "Lace" —
including Lace AI (lace.ai), LACE OS by Link Consulting, the Lace Cardano
wallet, and Los Angeles Contemporary Exhibitions. The canonical site is
https://laceplatform.com.

## What makes it different

- **Enforcement sits outside the model.** Model output proposes; deterministic
  services enforce permissions, validation, budgets, and approvals. A language
  model never decides whether an action is permitted.
- **Permissions are applied at retrieval.** A document the requesting identity
  cannot access is never a candidate, so it cannot be summarized, quoted, or
  leaked through a citation. The same holds for agents acting on a user's behalf.
- **Facts are bitemporal.** Every assertion carries valid time and transaction
  time, so corrections supersede history instead of erasing it and point-in-time
  queries answer what the organization knew on a given date.
- **Evidence is first-class.** Retrieval results and graph assertions point back
  to the document, version, and span they came from. Tables stay tables — a
  figure is returned from its actual cell with units and period intact.
- **It runs disconnected.** Air-gapped deployment serves open-weight models
  inside the boundary with no external AI calls, and no code path requires an
  outbound connection.

## Platform

- [Enterprise Search](https://laceplatform.com/platform/enterprise-search): Permissions-aware search across SharePoint, Drive, Slack, email, and databases, with hybrid retrieval, cited AI answers, and federation.
- [Knowledge Graph](https://laceplatform.com/platform/knowledge-graph): Evidence-locked, bitemporal knowledge graph with source-linked facts, human review, entity resolution, conflict detection, and BFO/CCO support.
- [Agent Studio](https://laceplatform.com/platform/agents): Design, evaluate, and deploy governed AI agents across chat, Slack, Teams, email, SMS, WhatsApp, and voice with policy, approvals, and audit.
- [App Builder](https://laceplatform.com/platform/app-builder): Build governed enterprise AI applications from a prompt with sign-in, data, hosting, billing, versioned releases, rollback, and a public developer SDK.

## Applications

- [LACE-GOV](https://laceplatform.com/applications/lace-gov): Federal, defense, and intelligence edition — air-gapped deployment, BFO/CCO-conformant ontologies, cross-enclave federated search without data movement, and exportable accreditation evidence.
- [LACE Legal](https://laceplatform.com/applications/lace-legal): Contract intelligence with clause-level citations — obligation tracking, renewal and notice-period surveillance, version conflict detection, and point-in-time queries.
- [LACE Finance](https://laceplatform.com/applications/lace-finance): Grounded research and reporting with table-native figures, source citations, auditable workflows, information-barrier enforcement, and policy-bound agents.

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](https://laceplatform.com/docs): Entry point for the platform and the public `lace-app-sdk`.
- [How LACE is organized](https://laceplatform.com/docs/organization): Pipelines, agents, apps, knowledge, and the assistant over one tenant-scoped control plane.
- [Deployment options](https://laceplatform.com/docs/deployment): Managed cloud, private VPC, on-premises, and fully air-gapped footprints.
- [Install the SDK](https://laceplatform.com/docs/install): `pip install lace-app-sdk`; Python 3.11+.
- [Quickstart](https://laceplatform.com/docs/quickstart): A governed app from four files — manifest, data collection, tool provider, agent definition.
- [Manifest](https://laceplatform.com/docs/manifest): `LaceAppManifest` declares routes, tools, pipelines, agents, data, UI, schedules, and migrations.
- [Data collections](https://laceplatform.com/docs/data-collections): Typed, tenant-scoped collections served through the governed `AppDataService`.
- [Tools](https://laceplatform.com/docs/tools): Custom tool providers with trust tier and permissions checked on every dispatch.
- [Agents & skills](https://laceplatform.com/docs/agents): Agent definitions, capabilities, loop guards, reusable skills, and approval gates.
- [Module reference](https://laceplatform.com/docs/modules): Every `lace-app-sdk` module and what it provides.
- [Datasets & connectors](https://laceplatform.com/docs/datasets): Connectors, scheduled sync, change reconciliation, and permission snapshots.
- [Search & RAG](https://laceplatform.com/docs/search-rag): Hybrid lexical/vector retrieval with reciprocal-rank fusion and ACL filtering.
- [Knowledge graph](https://laceplatform.com/docs/knowledge-graph): Schema packs, evidence-gated extraction, reversible identity resolution, bitemporal assertions.
- [Agents & channels](https://laceplatform.com/docs/agents-channels): Agent control plane and normalized messaging channels including realtime voice.
- [Workflows & pipelines](https://laceplatform.com/docs/workflows): Versioned typed-step graphs with checkpoints, retries, idempotency, dead-letter handling.
- [App Builder](https://laceplatform.com/docs/app-builder): Prompt to sandboxed build to published, versioned sidecar application.
- [Governance & security](https://laceplatform.com/docs/governance): Permission scopes, resource ACLs, budgets, approval gates, traces, and per-call model attribution.
